origin: Hybrid verification: published hKv1.5 activation fit and deactivation timescale; synthetic conductance density, capacitance, leak and topology. Not a tissue-calibrated channel.
manufactured_voltage: V*(t)=-0.045+0.002 exp(-t/0.02) sin(2 pi t/0.02), uniform across nodes
manufactured_gate: m*(t)=0.4+0.03 sin(2 pi t/0.02), uniform across nodes
integration: Native ChannelsABC.update_mh semi-implicit gating first; native FAST explicit voltage second. Synthetic channel and source hook, not packaged channel dispatch.
tau_scope: Published deactivation at -40 mV; treating as constant across dynamic V is an explicit unvalidated approximation
uncertainty_scope: Mean +/- one SEM, n=10; not a confidence interval or observed population extremes. Only tau uncertainty propagated.
physiological_match_status: No matched resting potential for CHO expressing hKv1.5 in selected study; holding voltage -80 mV is not resting potential
E_channel_origin: Ideal Nernst estimate from nominal solutions: 5.4 mM external K, 120 mM internal K excluding unreported added KOH; ideal activities; not measured reversal
